kill_rule: The arm's group 90% coverage does not improve on the candidate's beyond its interval (the lower end of the 90% event-cluster interval of the paired coverage difference, arm minus candidate, is not above zero), or the group's mean grid CRPS of the arm is above the candidate's (the arm loses). Pooled figures cannot pass or fail it alone, since everything outside the group is identical. A kill applies to a result that is not provisional; this one reads calendar columns at the target day on direct pairs.
label: development, not a verdict
reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c-ann-net) stays the frozen H5 candidate. Adopting the arm is hers; the 2 November freeze holds.
The group's intervals are event-cluster intervals over roughly 30 to 44 events: small. A pooled figure is never read alone: it is shown beside the group and the regime splits.
Even if coverage improves, the page says how far it stays short of 90%, as #1402's did (71.8%).
